flows.name: authoritative_command
steps: receive intent plus immutable target identity and base revision/preconditions
load current owning-domain truth inside authoritative transaction
revalidate lifecycle/dependencies/temporal inputs and command idempotency
apply owning-domain mutation and required lifecycle evidence
validate and insert required closed-schema audit event exactly once
commit all required authoritative writes atomically
publish/recompute disposable projections after or consistently with commit

flows.name: stale_command
steps: base revision/precondition no longer matches current truth
authoritative mutation is not applied
no accepted lifecycle or audit success event is fabricated
return current-vs-proposed conflict evidence for reviewed retry/rebase

flows.name: correction
steps: identify exact accepted event/relationship/fact being disputed
validate owning-domain correction eligibility
append correction/supersession/reversal evidence with independent chronology and reason
append required audit referencing both original and new evidence
recompute current projection without deleting the original accepted history

flows.name: temporal_input
steps: classify input as instant, date-only, duration, unknown or unresolved-source chronology
for Objective/Task schedule wall-clock input, convert using selected IANA scheduling zone and preserve context
persist known instant as UTC whole seconds
retain source/profile/offset conversion provenance where applicable
ambiguity or missing authority remains unresolved rather than fabricated

flows.name: projection_rebuild
steps: read accepted authoritative identities/relationships/events/snapshots
deterministically recompute current/list/dashboard/reportable projection
write/cache only disposable rebuildable state where used
emit no lifecycle event merely because derived state was recalculated

flows.name: exceptional_hard_delete
steps: owning domain proves explicit deletion eligibility and dependency safety
impact preview/confirmation is completed when required
transaction removes only the authorized mutable/domain record scope
independently surviving entities/evidence are preserved
required minimized non-reconstructable audit evidence is appended atomically
derived projections are rebuilt
